source_label: 本项目已有 GIF 案例
description_zh: 角色向镜头冲刺、头撞玻璃、裂纹扩散；可用已有猫咪动图预览。
prompt: Create a funny looping animated GIF of an original black-and-white cat headbutting the camera glass. Beat 1: cat stares intensely. Beat 2: it lunges head-first without using its paws. Beat 3: a small spiderweb crack appears, then grows. Beat 4: the camera returns to the starting view to loop. Keep the eyes, whisker markings and background consistent. Fixed camera; expressive but non-graphic cartoon impact; no words or watermark.

source_label: 本项目已有 GIF 案例
description_zh: 左右角色保持站位，单手抬起、摸头、收回，天然循环。
prompt: Create a seamless GIF with two ORIGINAL friendly cartoon characters. The taller blocky character on the left raises one hand, gently pats the shorter bald cartoon character on the head twice, then returns to the initial arm position. The receiver smiles and slightly nods in time. Keep faces, clothing, camera angle, grassy background and character positions unchanged. Clear contact and recovery poses, six to twelve distinct beats, no extra limbs, no captions.

description_zh: Reddit 帖附带的可播放 GIF（9 帧·390×437）已核到。帖文 JSON 本轮 403，作者 handle 与原文提示词未能独立复核，因此提示词仍标 reconstructed，不把第三方报告里的长提示词当逐字原文。
prompt: Animate an ORIGINAL anime-style adult character from a consistent front three-quarter portrait. She lifts her chin slightly, makes one quick affirmative nod, closes her eyes with a soft smile, then returns to the identical first-frame expression. Preserve hair strands, face proportions, outfit and line art between frames. Only the neck, eyelids and a few hair tips move. Simple clean background, locked camera, no speech bubbles, seamless looping GIF.

description_zh: 官方 Town 助手演示是 Vimeo 视频，不是 GIF。没有可复制提示词；封面 SVG 不是生成结果。
prompt: Create an original tiny mint-green desk companion mascot for an AI chat interface. It taps an invisible keyboard with alternating paws, pauses to blink, then returns to the start. Show only its head, tiny arms and torso on a transparent-looking plain solid background. Very small readable movement, fixed alignment and scale, no text, no chat bubbles, no UI mockup. Loop must feel calm and unobtrusive like a typing indicator.

description_zh: 官方发布页猫头鹰演示是 Vimeo 视频，不是 GIF。封面 SVG 不是生成结果。可播放的 2.6 草图 GIF 见 Veevid 墨线机器人（另一份素材）。
prompt: Make an original pencil-line owl drawing on cream notebook paper animate while preserving the hand-drawn sketch style. The owl blinks, tilts its head left, lifts one wing slightly, then returns to its original pencil pose. Keep the page fibers, outline weight and shading nearly static. No camera pan, no change of drawing identity, no extra strokes that drift between frames. Subtle, seamless looping GIF.

description_zh: Lightlyn 2.6 Sunburst 真实 GIF：盒盖开合、耳机浮起归位。提示词改回实测原文；只外链。
prompt: A white wireless earbuds charging case labelled "LIGHTLYN" on a sage-green studio background: the lid opens, the two earbuds rise and float a little, then settle back and the lid closes. Clean product animation, seamless loop.

description_zh: Veevid 2.6 Flare 真实 GIF：瓶子不动，高光扫过。提示词按博文原文；只外链。
prompt: A frosted glass perfume bottle on a round stone pedestal. The sequence: a soft band of light sweeps slowly across the glass from left to right while tiny dust particles drift upward. Fixed camera, same bottle, same pedestal, warm beige studio background. The last frame transitions smoothly back to the first for a seamless loop. Clean product photography style. No captions, no words, no logos, no borders.

description_zh: 实测关注多帧文字保持一致：霓虹牌 A/B 状态切换。
prompt: Nighttime rainy storefront with a single clean neon sign that alternates between the exact words OPEN and LATE, one at a time. The pink word OPEN slowly dims; blue LATE lights up, then reverses to the starting state. Keep all other lettering, reflections, windows, pavement and camera completely stable. Never display the two words at once. Crisp legible typography in every frame, no invented extra signs, seamless looping animated GIF.

description_zh: 官方 3×2 分镜提示词仍逐字收录。发布页股市演示是 Vimeo 视频，不是 GIF。封面 SVG 不是生成结果。
prompt: Create a single animation sprite sheet for a seamless looping GIF. A super-cute chibi adult office worker sits at a desk watching a computer monitor with a clearly plunging stock-market line chart. The sequence: hopeful expression, notices the chart falling, eyes widen, face crumples, large cartoon tears stream down both cheeks, then quietly wipes tears while still staring at the falling chart. Oversized round head, tiny body, big expressive eyes, soft rounded features, messy fluffy hair, white shirt and loosened tie. Exactly 6 sequential frames arranged in a precise 3-column by 2-row grid, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Every panel has identical dimensions. Fixed front three-quarter camera, same character, same desk, monitor, outfit, and cozy miniature office background. Clear incremental facial and tear motion; sixth frame transitions smoothly toward the first. Polished kawaii chibi 3D toy-like style, warm pastel lighting, funny and sympathetic mood. No captions, no words, no numbers, no logos, no speech bubbles, no panel labels, no borders, no gutters.

source_label: Morphic 公开提示词库（FAQ：示例不是 2.6，跑在 2.5 / Ideogram Vector）
description_zh: 开脑洞点：先做角色设定表，再用同一顶帽/腮红/领巾出 6 帧揉面→挥手循环，比单句「吉祥物招手」更能锁身份。Morphic 明示示例不是 ChatGPT Images 2.6（2.5 Flare/Sunburst 或 Ideogram Vector；Copilot 循环还用了 MiniMax 视频）。提示词面向 2.6 仍逐字收录；SVG 封面不是 2.6 成品，也不进入 2.6 GIF 画廊。
prompt: One animation sprite sheet for a looping GIF of the dough baker mascot from the sheet, same hat, cheeks and rust-red neckerchief: exactly 6 frames in a 3-column by 2-row grid, every panel the same size. Sequence: kneads a ball of dough, presses, folds, looks up and smiles, waves, and the sixth frame leads back into the first. Fixed front three-quarter camera, the same oak counter and plain oat-colored background in every panel, the same soft clay-like 3D render. No text, no numbers, no borders, no gutters, no panel labels.

source_label: Morphic 公开提示词库（FAQ：示例不是 2.6，跑在 2.5 / Ideogram Vector）
description_zh: 开脑洞点：不是照片微动，而是整条鱼用层叠色纸游一圈；俯视锁定、第六帧接回第一帧，适合做手工质感 sticker。Morphic 明示示例不是 ChatGPT Images 2.6（2.5 Flare/Sunburst 或 Ideogram Vector；Copilot 循环还用了 MiniMax 视频）。提示词面向 2.6 仍逐字收录；SVG 封面不是 2.6 成品，也不进入 2.6 GIF 画廊。
prompt: One animation sprite sheet for a looping GIF: exactly 6 frames in a 3-column by 2-row grid, every panel the same size. A papercraft koi made of layered cut paper in vermilion, cream and ink black swims one slow circle through a still pond of deep teal paper ripples, its tail sweeping a little further in each frame, and the sixth frame leads smoothly back into the first. Fixed overhead camera, the same pond, lily pad and soft paper shadows in every panel, warm diffused light, tactile handmade texture. No text, no borders, no gutters, no panel labels.

description_zh: 开脑洞点：2.6 把 ChatGPT 圈选 markup 接到 API。透明 PNG 叠层指出位置，提示词只说改什么、什么必须留下，并删掉红圈。
prompt: Recolor the striped vase inside the red circle to solid cobalt blue ceramic. Keep its shape, the dried stems, and the rest of the kitchen unchanged. Remove the red circle from the finished photo.

description_zh: 开脑洞点：局部改图不是重画整张海报，而是圈出招牌、指定精确文案，并要求匹配原字体、颜色和透视。
prompt: Change the words on the sign inside the circle to "[OPEN LATE]". Match the original lettering, color and perspective. Keep everything else unchanged.

title_zh: 可缩放面包店 SVG 标志
description_zh: 开脑洞点：生成接口可直接 output_format=svg，得到可改路径的矢量标，而不是嵌了位图的假矢量。官方同时给了 Flare/Sunburst 对照。
prompt:
Create an original, non-infringing logo for a company called Field & Flour, a local bakery.
The logo should feel warm, simple, and timeless. Use clean, vector-like shapes, a strong silhouette, and balanced negative space.
Favor simplicity over detail so it reads clearly at small and large sizes. Flat design, minimal strokes, no gradients unless essential.
Fully transparent background. Deliver a single centered logo with generous padding, clean alpha edges, and no solid backdrop, scenery, checkerboard, or watermark.

title_zh: 天气图标 SVG 套件
description_zh: 开脑洞点：一次生成 6 个同线宽、同端点的图标，而不是 6 次风格漂移。Lightlyn 实测 SVG 约 2–13 KB，可进 Figma。
prompt: A set of six matching line icons for a weather app arranged in a 3 by 2 grid: sun, cloud, rain, snow, thunderstorm, wind. Consistent stroke width, rounded ends, one accent colour.

source_label: Morphic 公开提示词库（FAQ：示例不是 2.6，跑在 2.5 / Ideogram Vector）
description_zh: 开脑洞点：2.6 可保存参考图并按名调用。先出正/侧/背 + 表情条，再拿去出分镜或新场景，比口头描述更稳。Morphic 明示示例不是 ChatGPT Images 2.6（2.5 Flare/Sunburst 或 Ideogram Vector；Copilot 循环还用了 MiniMax 视频）。提示词面向 2.6 仍逐字收录；SVG 封面不是 2.6 成品，也不进入 2.6 GIF 画廊。
prompt: A character reference sheet for an invented bakery's mascot: a small round baker made of soft bread dough, with a tiny white chef hat, flour-dusted cheeks and a rust-red neckerchief, shown three times at the same scale, front view, side view and back view, with a row of four small facial expressions beneath (cheerful, proud, sleepy, surprised). Soft clay-like 3D render with visible fingerprint texture, warm even studio light, plain oat-colored background, identical proportions and colors in every view. No text, no labels, no logos.

description_zh: 开脑洞点：把设定表当 image 输入，只改动作与环境，并逐项点名脸、头发、服装、配色不许变。
prompt: Using the character in the reference image, show them [crossing a rope bridge in the rain]. Keep the face, hair, outfit and colors the same.

description_zh: 官方文档真实 GIF（9×200 ms、512²、Sunburst）：小猴提灯、眨眼、放回。封面改为源站 GIF 外链，不再用 SVG 冒充生成结果。Sogni 另有哈希不同的第三方重跑。xianyu110 镜像与官方字节一致，不另收。
prompt: A little monkey in an olive-green hooded coat stands in a snowy pine forest at dusk. A wooden cabin glows in the background. The monkey holds a glowing amber paper lantern at chest height, slowly lifts it, looks up and blinks, then lowers it back to its starting pose. Keep the lantern in its hands and the camera still. Make the motion loop smoothly.

description_zh: 开脑洞点：短循环不是角色在动，而是徽章钉死、火花在闪，并把要印的字放进引号要求逐字拼写。
prompt: Make a looping GIF of a round badge that says "[50% OFF]" with small sparkles appearing around it. Spell the text exactly. Keep the badge in one place.

source_label: Morphic 公开提示词库（FAQ：示例不是 2.6，跑在 2.5 / Ideogram Vector）
description_zh: 开脑洞点：不是拍成品包装，而是一次画出六面展开图、折叠虚线和两句精确文案，给包装设计预演。Morphic 明示示例不是 ChatGPT Images 2.6（2.5 Flare/Sunburst 或 Ideogram Vector；Copilot 循环还用了 MiniMax 视频）。提示词面向 2.6 仍逐字收录；SVG 封面不是 2.6 成品，也不进入 2.6 GIF 画廊。
prompt: A flat packaging dieline for an unbranded loose-leaf tea carton laid out on a pale grey surface: front, back, two sides, top and bottom panels unfolded. Front panel reads HIGHLAND BREAKFAST with a small mountain line illustration; back panel has a short brewing guide reading STEEP 4 MINUTES AT 95 C. Sage green and cream with a thin gold rule, dotted fold lines between panels. Every word spelled correctly, no other text, no barcodes, no logos.
example_run_model: GPT Image 2.5 Flare/Sunburst（Morphic FAQ：示例不是 2.6）

source_label: Morphic 公开提示词库（FAQ：示例不是 2.6，跑在 2.5 / Ideogram Vector）
description_zh: 开脑洞点：把 complexity 写进提示词——六区六块牌、每词只出现一次，并禁止门窗再长字。适合信息图与空间说明。Morphic 明示示例不是 ChatGPT Images 2.6（2.5 Flare/Sunburst 或 Ideogram Vector；Copilot 循环还用了 MiniMax 视频）。提示词面向 2.6 仍逐字收录；SVG 封面不是 2.6 成品，也不进入 2.6 GIF 画廊。
prompt: Isometric cutaway illustration of a small corner bakery seen from above at a 45-degree angle, the front wall removed. Six areas, each with one short label on a small plaque, exactly once each: OVEN, PROOFING, COUNTER, PANTRY, SINK, SEATING. A baker shaping loaves, a customer at the counter, trays of bread cooling on racks, warm pastel palette, clean line work, soft shadows, plenty of fine detail. Those six plaques are the only text in the image: the door, windows, boxes and walls carry no signs or writing. Every word spelled correctly, no logos.

source_label: Morphic 公开提示词库（FAQ：示例不是 2.6，跑在 2.5 / Ideogram Vector）
description_zh: 开脑洞点：分轮编辑的最小单位——上一张海报只改标题和配色，版式不动。比一次重写整张更接近生产改稿。Morphic 明示示例不是 ChatGPT Images 2.6（2.5 Flare/Sunburst 或 Ideogram Vector；Copilot 循环还用了 MiniMax 视频）。提示词面向 2.6 仍逐字收录；SVG 封面不是 2.6 成品，也不进入 2.6 GIF 画廊。

description_zh: 开脑洞点：不是透明背景招贴，而是把海报贴进真实橱窗，要求 AUTUMN BAKE / EMBER & OAT 拼写正确，并禁止多余日期网址。Morphic 明示示例不是 ChatGPT Images 2.6（2.5 Flare/Sunburst 或 Ideogram Vector；Copilot 循环还用了 MiniMax 视频）。提示词面向 2.6 仍逐字收录；SVG 封面不是 2.6 成品，也不进入 2.6 GIF 画廊。

Headline AUTUMN BAKE in a bold rounded serif in rust red, a smaller line beneath reading EMBER & OAT, a two-color illustration of a scored loaf and wheat stalks in rust and deep green on cream paper, visible riso grain and slight misregistration, faint reflections of the street on the glass. Every word spelled correctly, no other text, no dates, no web addresses.

source_label: Max Goldstein @Krouxzz · 作者声明 2.6 · X API animated_gif · HEAD video/mp4 · 未视觉复核

prompt: Make a looping GIF of this character waving.

description_zh: Lightlyn 2.6 Flare 真实图生 GIF：杯子/桌子/窗户不动，只动蒸汽和光。Veevid 文生咖啡蒸汽、狗摇尾是同一「微动」玩法的样本，不另开蒸汽/摇尾卡。
prompt: Make this photo move: gentle steam rises and curls above the latte, soft light flickers slightly. Keep the cup, the table and the window exactly as they are. Seamless loop.

description_zh: 路飞中文挥手玩法（逐字提示词）。封面仍为原创 SVG，不转载路飞 GIF。同玩法的 2.6 真 GIF 样本见画廊：Lightlyn 橘猫、Veevid 仙人掌/狐狸，不另开挥手卡。
prompt:
生成一个约 1 秒、可循环播放的 GIF 聊天表情。
角色：原创小水獭，奶咖色皮毛、奶油白嘴部、短圆耳朵，穿向日葵黄色连帽雨衣，头顶一只很小的蓝色纸船。
风格：软萌 3D 黏土玩具，大头小身体，轮廓干净。
动作：水獭面朝镜头微笑，举起右手，左右轻轻挥手，再放回胸口，接回开头。
正方形画面，纯白背景，全身完整。
相机固定，角色的大小、位置、服装和配色不变。
只做挥手，不跳跃、不转身、不切镜头。
不要文字、编号、边框、水印或额外角色。
请输出可以下载和播放的 GIF 文件，不要只给静态预览图。

title_zh: 六宫格连续帧再合成 GIF
description_zh: 开脑洞点：表情轮播≠连续运动。先出无间隔 3×2 六格，再切帧对齐身体中心合成循环。下面两段按原文发表顺序收录，不是本站改写；封面为原创 SVG。
prompt:
以上传图片为角色参考，生成一张连续动作分镜图。
横向 3:2 画面，严格 3 列 2 行，共 6 个等大的正方形格子。
每格纯白背景，不画分隔线，不留格子之间的间隔。
按从左到右、从上到下排列。
第 1 格：右手放在胸口。
第 2 格：右手抬到肩膀。
第 3 格：抬至脸旁，向外摆。
第 4 格：向内摆。
第 5 格：再向外摆。
第 6 格：放回胸口附近，方便接回第 1 格。
所有格子保持同一个角色、同一服装和表情。
身体中心、脚底位置、镜头距离和角色大小固定。
左手自然垂下，不增加道具、文字、编号或边框。

请按 3 列 2 行切出这 6 帧，从左到右、从上到下播放。
每秒约 6 帧，合成为无限循环的 GIF。
保留纯白背景，画布大小一致。
如果角色位置有轻微偏移，先对齐身体中心和脚底，再合成。
给我可下载的 GIF 文件。

title_zh: 同一角色九宫格表情包
description_zh: 开脑洞点：先锁脸型/毛色/衣服，再换九种聊天情绪，中文短词固定在角色上方。比每次从零描述人物更不容易长歪。不转载原文九宫格成品。
prompt:
以上传图片为唯一角色参考，制作一张九宫格聊天表情包。
先提取角色最容易辨认的特征：脸型、发型或毛色、衣服、配饰、主要配色。
把这些特征保留在每一个表情中，不更换人物。
风格：软萌 3D 黏土玩具，大头小身体，轮廓清楚。
严格 3 列 3 行，每个格子等大，纯白背景，不画网格线。
从左到右、从上到下依次制作：
挥手，文字“早呀”。
双手合十，文字“谢谢”。
敬礼，文字“收到”。
委屈掉泪，文字“委屈”。
瘫坐，文字“累了”。
兴奋挥拳，文字“好耶”。
抱着爱心，文字“爱你”。
叉腰，文字“不干”。
盖着小毯子，文字“晚安”。
中文位于每个角色上方，清晰准确。
每个表情独立完整，四周留白，不重叠、不裁切。
不要水印、品牌标志、编号或多余角色。

description_zh: 开脑洞点：改图把「改什么」和「保留什么」拆开写。这段只换墙色，瓶子形状、水珠、豆粒数量和台面颜色都点名留下。
prompt:
只把背景墙从奶油米色改为低饱和的深墨绿色。
保留原图瓶子的形状、尺寸、位置、银色瓶盖、水珠、琥珀色液体、台面纹理、咖啡豆数量与位置。
镜头角度、光照方向和画面构图保持不变。
不要改变台面颜色，不要增加文字、Logo、花草、杯子或额外瓶子。
输出与原图相同比例的照片。

title_zh: 清晰化但不要编造细节
description_zh: 开脑洞点：低清修复要禁止「8K 堆砌」和编造看不清的标签/人脸。适合整理压缩图，不能把补出来的纹理当成原图信息。
prompt:
请对这张低清图片做自然的清晰化处理。
去除明显压缩块和模糊感，整理主体边缘、材质和色彩层次。
保留原图主体的形状、比例、位置、配色、背景、光线方向和画面裁切。
不要换一种画风，不要过度锐化，不要增加原图没有的文字、装饰或物品。
如果某处细节已经看不清，不要自行编造标签内容或人脸特征。
输出与原图相同比例的高清晰度图片。

title_en: Stage Soft Furnishings, Keep the Room
description_zh: 开脑洞点：室内改图先锁门窗、墙角、尺度和透视，只换地毯/靠垫/茶几。比一句「改成豪宅」更接近能下单的搭配预览。
prompt:
基于这张客厅照片做软装搭配预览，只更换软装和茶几，不改变空间结构。
保持原有门窗、墙角、天花板、房间尺度、地板和镜头透视位置。
保留同一张沙发的位置与外形。
把黑色长方茶几换成浅橡木椭圆茶几。
沙发前增加奶油白短绒地毯。
靠垫换成鼠尾草绿与米白色。
沙发后墙挂两幅小尺寸抽象植物装饰画。
窗边放一盆中等大小绿植，加轻薄白纱帘。
保留原有自然光方向，不移门窗，不增加壁炉、隔断或吊顶，不把房间扩大。

prompt:
Create a coordinated set of 10 animated reaction GIFs featuring the main character in Image 1, using Image 2 as the visual style reference.

How to use the references

Image 1 defines the character: preserve their recognizable identity, distinctive features, clothing, and accessories while translating them into the target style. Adapt gestures to the character’s anatomy.
Image 2 defines the visual style: match its medium, rendering, shapes, proportions, color palette, lighting, textures, level of detail, and overall mood. Let this reference determine whether the result is photographic, illustrated, cartoon-like, painterly, pixel art, clay, plush, or another aesthetic.
Apply that style consistently to the character, setting, props, and captions.
Draw the setting from Image 1 where useful, simplifying or restyling it to suit Image 2.
Keep the same character design, camera angle, framing, and visual treatment across all ten GIFs.
Keep the reactions funny, expressive, and uncluttered. Let gestures, expressions, and timing carry the humor.

Create these eight fixed reactions with short captions:

(1) When I didn’t understand anything the other person said.
(2) When I need more context.
(3) When I don’t know what to do.
(4) When something was probably supposed to be funny, but wasn’t.
(5) When the other person is sad.
(6) When someone complains yet again about their actually pretty good life.
(7) When acknowledging information or instructions.
(8) When getting started on a task.

Invent two additional reactions inspired specifically by Image 1.

Find distinctive gestures, objects, clothing, or details in the setting. Turn two of those cues into useful, funny chat reactions with short captions. Make them distinct from the eight above.

For example, a hand-heart pose might inspire “LOVE THIS.” and a coffee mug might inspire “BUT FIRST, COFFEE.” Choose reactions that fit the actual input image.

Animation and captions:

Each GIF must be 1:1, 512 × 512 pixels, approximately four seconds long, and loop forever.
Give each reaction a readable beginning, gesture, brief hold, and return. Animate the character’s face and limbs, rather than relying on camera movement.
Match the movement and timing to the visual style: subtle expressions, exaggerated cartoon gestures, stepped stop-motion, or another appropriate approach.

Choose caption typography, color, and treatment that complement Image 2. If it contains no typography, select a simple, readable treatment that fits its aesthetic.
Keep captions consistent and legible at small sizes, positioned away from faces and important gestures. Include only the requested caption.

Deliverables

Use image generation to create the visuals and assemble them into actual animated GIF files. Do not stop at concepts, still images, or sprite sheets.

Deliver:

All ten individual GIFs.
A ZIP containing all ten.
One animated gallery GIF arranged in 5 columns × 2 rows, in the order listed above.

Input Images:

1つの連続したアクションを、4列×4行の合計16フレームで表現する。

【スプライトシート仕様】
・正方形キャンバス
・4列×4行、合計16フレーム
・16個のセルは完全に同じ大きさ
・各セルの上下左右に最低10pxの余白を確保する
・枠線、グリッド線、数字、文字、記号、UIは一切不要
・背景は全フレームで統一された単色の白
・各フレームは左上から右へ、上段から下段へ、時間順に並べる

・16フレームすべてでキャラクターの表示倍率を統一する
・カメラのズームイン、ズームアウトは禁止
・足元の接地面の基準線を同じ高さに固定する
・キャラクターの中心位置がフレームの前後で大きく移動しない
・動きに必要な範囲だけポーズを変える

・余白10pxの安全領域を侵さない
・アクションが大きくなっても、キャラクターを縮小して調整しない
・必要ならエフェクトや腕の振り幅を控えめにして、セル内に収める

【描画方針】
・2Dゲーム用スプライトとして読みやすい、明快なシルエット
・フレーム間で自然につながる動き
・1枚絵ではなく、アニメーション素材として破綻のない連続性を重視
・各フレームの描き込み密度、線、塗り、陰影を統一する

prompt:

Show one continuous action in 4 columns × 4 rows, 16 frames in total.

[Sprite sheet spec]
- Square canvas
- 4 columns × 4 rows, 16 frames in total
- All 16 cells exactly the same size
- At least 10 px of margin on every side of each cell
- No borders, grid lines, numbers, letters, symbols or UI at all
- One plain white background, the same in every frame
- Frames in time order: left to right, top row to bottom row

[Most important: fixed size and position]
- The same character scale in all 16 frames
- No camera zoom in or out
- The ground line under the feet fixed at the same height
- The character's centre does not move much from one frame to the next
- Change the pose only as much as the motion needs

[Most important: everything inside its cell]
- Hair, clothes, arms and legs, weapons, props, effects, afterimages and particles all stay inside their own cell
- Nothing spills into the next cell
- Nothing enters the 10 px safety margin
- Even when the action gets bigger, do not shrink the character to make it fit
- If needed, tone down effects and arm swings so they stay in the cell

[Drawing]
- A clear silhouette that reads well as a 2D game sprite
- Motion that flows naturally from frame to frame
- Not a single illustration: unbroken continuity as animation material comes first
- The same detail, line, colour and shading in every frame
prompt_adaptation:
用我上传的原创角色全身侧面图，按同一规格各出一张表，不要混在一张里（本站策划，不是 varg 原文）：

1) 待机：原地呼吸与重心微移，4–6 个有效关键帧即可，其余格重复过渡。
2) 跑：侧面循环跑，接触→下沉→交换→上提，再对侧。腾空帧不要事后把脚拉回地面。
3) 攻击：预备→挥击→命中→回收。武器不得画出格子。

正方形 4×4、等大格、10px 边距、脚底基准线固定、禁止变焦。白底（非真 alpha）或在支持时写 transparent background。一格一个动作，不要待机和跑画在同一张。切帧后对齐脚底，导出循环 GIF 只作预览；游戏导入用图集 PNG+JSON。未实测生成。
acceptance: 16 格等大；角色不缩放；跑循环能接回第 1 帧；白底抠色不是真 alpha；有引擎工程/录像才算已用于游戏。本条没有。
